print: SETTLED_CALLS.md 3b: the tape of record's mid at the market's `time` (first row at/after within 60 s) against `threshold`
registration: every active binaryPrice market on a declared coin in each capture of day D whose expiry is at least 300 s after the capture's registration and inside D; once per market per leg across the day's captures (the earlier registration stands)
size: paper: the account's quarter-Kelly stake (A40 R164); live: R167
frozen_by: PREREG A40, 2026-11-10; changed only by a dated amendment and never after a number has been seen (S71)
rule: for each qualifying market: the side whose captured price is higher (YES if equal) — the main ledger's L2 rule at every capture of the day

parameter.favorite: the higher-priced side at capture, one fixed parameter

burn_in.rule: the favorite goes LIVE under L2_market_favorite.json's burn-in (A35) as A40 R167 words it: >= 5 full days resolved and the leg's loss rate below its control's on k_for(N) consecutive days; then one 11 USDC ticket a call by a dated amendment naming the account
burn_in.why: the panel @ 45:03: deploy when it beats the bench, throw it away when it doesn't

kill.rule: RETIRED, sticky, when the loss rate is at or above the control's plus 0.05 on 5 consecutive resolved days, or fewer than 10 resolved calls on 3 consecutive days (A35's words); and A40 R168: at 5 marked days with the account's equity at or below C0's 11.00 the line reads 'not a bet; capital is the limiting factor'

mechanism: the crowd's price as the call, read fresh every hour (S71: a frozen rule chosen for its simplicity)
